title: Billing has no tests at all.
why_it_matters: Billing changes ship untested, so a pricing bug reaches customers before anyone sees it.
remediation: Add tests in apps/api/src/billing/__tests__/ for webhook handling and proration first.
verified_by: Ran the coverage report and listed the test folders.

title: The README promises CSV export and SSO, but neither exists in the code.
evidence:
- Export any report to CSV
- Single sign-on for teams
why_it_matters: Customers and agents both trust the README; promising missing features creates support load and wrong assumptions.
remediation: Either remove the two lines from README.md or open PRDs for them.
verified_by: Searched the codebase for CSV export and SSO entry points; none.

title: 57 TypeScript errors appear when strict mode is turned on.
why_it_matters: Loose types let null and undefined bugs through to runtime.
remediation: Turn on strict in tsconfig.json for new files first with a per-folder override, then fix the 57 errors.
verified_by: Ran tsc --strict --noEmit on a throwaway copy.
